title: WeKnora MCP stdio configuration command injection
summary: MCP stdio client configuration concatenates untrusted command fields into process execution (CVE-2026-22688).

threat_model.attacker: user or config supplier controlling MCP stdio command fields
threat_model.boundary: MCP client config → OS process start
threat_model.impact: OS command injection leading to remote code execution

patch_sketch: Avoid shell; exec argv arrays; validate allowlisted binaries.
